name: no-claude-help
description: Keeps coding agents off the byline: no co-authored-by trailers, no session URLs, no generated-with footers, no agent contributors, and every commit authored by the human.

author_identity.title: Commit identity
author_identity.description: The only identity commits may carry, as "Name <email>". Leave empty to use the existing git user.name and user.email.

auto_install_git_hooks.title: Install git hooks automatically
auto_install_git_hooks.description: Install the enforcement hooks into each repository you open, so the rule holds for other agents, editors and CI too.

strict_mode.title: Strict mode
strict_mode.description: Also reject generic [bot] commit identities, not only known AI agents. Release and dependency bots stay allowed.
